title: Cost and Cost-effectiveness of PTB+ Treatment in Southern Ethiopia
brief_summary: Evidences for policy making and decision related to the cost of delivering tuberculosis (TB) control is lacking in Ethiopia. The investigators aimed to determine the cost and cost-effectiveness of involving health extension workers (HEWs) in TB treatment under the community-based initiative in Ethiopia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pulmonary tuberculosis suspects of any age and sex

Exclusion Criteria:

* Healthy individuals or non tuberculosis patients
study_population: This study was conducted along a CRT to find out if involving HEWs improves the treatment success rate of smear-positive patients. For both treatment alternatives, smear-positive patients who were diagnosed (from September 2006 to September 2007) and started treatment were prospectively enrolled until the end of treatment. The detail of the study are given elsewhere
